title: Those British Strawberries Are Being Picked by Central Asian Workers
description: Ten years after Brexit, most seasonal workers in Britain are from countries such as Kyrgyzstan and Tajikistan. Without them, agricultural chiefs say, many farms would fail.

title: 21-year-old fatally shot in the head on NYC street
description: The 21-year-old man was discovered with a gunshot wound to his head outside of a building on East 187th Street between Webster and Park Avenues just before 7 p.m.

title: Geno Smith’s alleged battery being ‘further investigated’ by police after case was said to be closed
description: Police in Davie, Florida, are reversing course after originally saying that an investigation into Geno Smith over an alleged battery had been closed.
